responsibility: Defines the solver’s canonical-query boundary operations on `EvalCtxt`: canonicalizing goals before evaluation, constructing canonical responses with external region and opaque-type constraints, instantiating returned canonical variables back into the caller, unifying response values with original query inputs, and reapplying returned region constraints.
same_name_distinction: Among the `solve/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the canonical-query boundary layer for the new solver. It is the module that turns in-progress goals into canonical queries and turns canonical responses back into local inference state, whereas `solve/mod.rs` drives overall goal evaluation and `search_graph/mod.rs` manages recursion, cycles, and caching.
